description: List filament stock for accounts that track filament by weight instead of by spool (mode "stock"): one row per material profile and color and per location holding it (id is the row: the material at one place, the stock_id every action takes; stockId is the material), with grams there (amountG) and in all (totalG), what is loaded on printers, value, grams used in the last 30 days and daysLeft at that rate. Use this, not list_filaments, when the mode is "stock". Weights are grams.
name: list_filament_stock
